rules: base/ must contain deployment.yaml, service.yaml, and kustomization.yaml
Each overlay must have its own kustomization.yaml referencing ../../base
Use namePrefix in each overlay to scope resource names per environment
Use commonLabels in base kustomization.yaml with app and version labels
Pin image tags in overlays — never use latest in any environment
Resource limits (cpu, memory) must be set in the base deployment
Liveness and readiness probes must be defined in the base deployment
